title: Screen the four-end histogram inside one incumbent grid cell
body:
## Summary
- The exhibited four-end profile `{1:2400, 2:446, 3:416, 4:142, 5:82, 8:8}` has rank mass 5,582 and idle mass 1,650. No other partition was searched.
- At grid `1/10^12`, `ceiling.ceiling` returns the cell from `33803961/20000000000` to `1690198051/1000000000000`. The note's bracket `0.001690198050302 < best ceiling < 0.001690198050303` lies inside that cell.
- The high endpoint exceeds the selected ceiling by less than `0.00852%`. The selected saving stays below the cap. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
